title: plan.json
description: The desired folder structure as a flat, ordered node list. Flat because a diff must be readable and because `add` is a single append: that is what makes bootstrap and new-area the same code.

primaryMultiplicity.description: What the workspace has many of, where each accumulates its own context. This one answer determines the shape of the tree; it is why the template ships no domain profiles.

role.description: router: has children with their own CLAUDE.md, points down only. leaf: fat context, full section skeleton. plain: ambient folder, no CLAUDE.md.

instanceTemplate.description: The template each child instance gets. Its presence is how `add` infers a parent from a name without asking.
